color.note: Dark-first: dark is the primary theme, light mirrors it. Neutral almost everywhere; one accent per page carries all the colour.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere: header, post body, footer. The ground every text token is checked on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels on canvas: post cards, code blocks, callouts, inline code, the search field.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for cards, menu rows and ghost buttons; table header rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the full-width rules between header, post header, hero and body; card and image borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: inputs, outlined icon buttons, checkboxes, tag borders on hover. 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, post titles, active nav links, the active table-of-contents item. On canvas, surface and surface-strong.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Article body copy and lead paragraphs: softer than ink so headings lead. On canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: breadcrumbs, dates, reading time, inactive TOC items, captions, footer links. On canvas and surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in prose (always underlined). On canvas, surface and every *-soft fill.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Inline link on hover and while pressed. On canvas and surface.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button (the solid CTA in the header): the brightest thing on the page.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an inverse fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (see the focus-ring shadow). 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-strong.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Red accent mark: TOC active bar, badge border, hero arc, dots. 3:1 on canvas. Default accent; security, breaking changes, retirements, the Caution callout.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red text: badge label, callout title. On canvas, surface and red-soft.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Red tinted fill behind red-ink: badges, callouts.

tokens.name: red-glow
tokens.usage: Red hero glow: the far end of the hero-art gradient and grid lines. Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Orange accent mark: TOC active bar, badge border, hero arc, dots. 3:1 on canvas. Deprecations, upcoming changes, the Warning callout.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text: badge label, callout title. On canvas, surface and orange-soft.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Orange tinted fill behind orange-ink: badges, callouts.

tokens.name: orange-glow
tokens.usage: Orange hero glow: the far end of the hero-art gradient and grid lines. Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Green accent mark: TOC active bar, badge border, hero arc, dots. 3:1 on canvas. Releases, improvements, the Tip callout.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green text: badge label, callout title. On canvas, surface and green-soft.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Green tinted fill behind green-ink: badges, callouts.

tokens.name: green-glow
tokens.usage: Green hero glow: the far end of the hero-art gradient and grid lines. Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Blue accent mark: TOC active bar, badge border, hero arc, dots. 3:1 on canvas. Guides, docs and the Note callout. Kept apart from link blue by tone; never put an accent-blue mark next to a link.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text: badge label, callout title. On canvas, surface and blue-soft.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Blue tinted fill behind blue-ink: badges, callouts.

tokens.name: blue-glow
tokens.usage: Blue hero glow: the far end of the hero-art gradient and grid lines. Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Purple accent mark: TOC active bar, badge border, hero arc, dots. 3:1 on canvas. Research, community, opinion pieces, the Important callout.

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: Purple text: badge label, callout title. On canvas, surface and purple-soft.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Purple tinted fill behind purple-ink: badges, callouts.

tokens.name: purple-glow
tokens.usage: Purple hero glow: the far end of the hero-art gradient and grid lines. Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current story's accent mark. Components use accent, never a hue directly; a post or category re-points it (data-accent). Default: red.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The current accent as text: badge labels, callout titles. Follows accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The current accent's tinted fill behind accent-ink. Follows accent.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: The current accent's hero glow. Follows accent.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Plain code in code blocks and inline code, on surface.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments in code blocks, italic. On surface.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (const, return, import) in code blocks. On surface.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings, regexes and URLs in code blocks. On surface.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function and class names in code blocks. On surface.

tokens.name: code-constant
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans and constants in code blocks. On surface.

tokens.name: code-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, properties and attribute names in code blocks. On surface.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Tight, confident headlines. Sentence case, centred on post pages.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The blog's own name or a landing hero. Once per page at most.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Faster releases: what changed in our pipeline
styles.usage: Post title on the article page, desktop. ink on canvas.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.sample: Faster releases: what changed in our pipeline
styles.usage: Post title below bp-md; featured post card title.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Inside articles. Never skip a level.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Article sections; each one appears in the table of contents.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small run-in headings: 'Why this matters', 'What you need to do'.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body copy is ink-body; headings and the first words of a list item may be ink.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We're rolling this out over five weeks so you have time to adapt.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a post, card excerpts on the featured card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Shorter lifetimes limit the window of exposure when a token leaks.
styles.usage: Article prose, list items. Measure: the measure token.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Read how the new limits affect your workflows.
styles.usage: Card excerpts, footer copy, TOC items, form help text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 2. Median publish time before and after.
styles.usage: Image and table captions in ink-muted.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Header nav links, buttons, form labels.

groups.name: Meta
groups.note: Mono in capitals (text-transform: uppercase) is the system's signature: metadata, never sentences.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase. Dates, reading time, breadcrumbs ('← Back to changelog'), author line. ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Badge and tag labels, one or two words.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks; inline code at 0.88em of the surrounding text on surface.

spacing.note: 4px base. Prose rhythm comes from space-6 between paragraphs and space-12 above an h2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges and meta lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and tags; gap between a heading and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between TOC items; list-item gap; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; card inner gap; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Callout and code-block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs; card padding; header item gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter from bp-md; gap between post cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Badge-and-meta block to title; between a figure and the next paragraph.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above every h2; between the post header and the hero.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the post body band; between index sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top padding of the post header band; above the footer.

radius.note: Mostly square-ish; full rounds only for tags and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inline code, the TOC active bar.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Post cards, code blocks, callouts, images in posts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Category tags (pills), avatars, the hero arc.

shadow.note: Hairlines, not shadows. Only floating things and focus get one.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: the search dialog, menus, the mobile TOC sheet.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid focus colour (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).

layout.note: Page anatomy widths. The article reads in one column of measure; the TOC sits to its right from bp-lg.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the article column (about 72 characters of body).

tokens.name: toc-width
tokens.usage: Width of the sticky 'On this page' rail from bp-lg.

tokens.name: wide
tokens.usage: Breakout width for wide figures, tables and the post-index grid.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of header, footer and the hero band's content.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height; also the sticky offset for the TOC and anchor scroll-margin.

tokens.name: hero-height
tokens.usage: Height of the hero-art band on post pages from bp-md (240px below).

breakpoint.note: Mobile first. Use as min-width media queries (CSS variables can't be used inside them; copy the value).

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Two-column post grid starts.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Desktop header nav replaces the menu button; title replaces title-sm; gutter space-8.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: TOC rail appears beside the article; three-column post grid.
